chief_complaint: Preventive health maintenance, including hypertension management and follow‑up of a recently identified colon polyp
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 50‑year‑old male with a longstanding history of essential hypertension (diagnosed 2013) managed with low‑dose amlodipine and hydrochlorothiazide, obesity (BMI ≥30 since 2015), and prediabetes (A1c 5.9%). He has chronic anemia diagnosed in 2009 and receives monthly vitamin B12 injections, suggesting a B12‑deficiency component. In August 2019 a colonoscopy identified a colon polyp. He reports persistent social isolation and limited social contact despite full‑time employment and higher education. Over the past 12 visits, nine were wellness visits; there have been no emergency or inpatient encounters. Recent vital signs, lipid panel, renal function, and detailed anemia work‑up are unavailable.
